writing.overall_comment: A well-scoped, clearly routeable frontend subagent with strong boundaries and output contract, held back only by redundant best-practice sections that could be trimmed.

dimensions.name: Delegation fit
dimensions.comment: The description clearly names the trigger (building/styling/refactoring frontend features, components, pages, state) and the frameworks covered, so a main agent can route reliably.

dimensions.name: Prompt quality
dimensions.comment: Role, tiered responsibilities, workflow, and an explicit output contract (working files plus summary of changes/runs/assumptions) are all stated, though the role could be tightened to reduce overlap.

dimensions.name: Boundaries
dimensions.comment: Clear frontend-only scope, a firm 'don't switch the stack' rule, greenfield guidance, and explicit hand-back-to-main-agent conditions make the limits unambiguous.

dimensions.name: Conciseness
dimensions.comment: The 'Common Best Practices' block and Framework-Specific Focus largely restate points already made in Core Responsibilities and Adaptive Selection, spending tokens on redundancy.

suggestions: In the 'Common Best Practices' block, remove or fold into 'Core Responsibilities' any bullet that repeats a point already made there, then delete the now-empty block.
In 'Framework-Specific Focus,' cut guidance that duplicates 'Adaptive Selection' and retain only framework-specific details not stated elsewhere.
